target: Violate HACKDAC_p4: it must never happen that PWDATA == 0x12345678 while s_apb_addr targets the lock register (5'b10010) and r_gpio_lock already holds 0x12345678.

milestones.description: System reset applied, GPIO lock register cleared
Reset released, APB bus becomes active
APB write transaction to GPIO lock register address
GPIO lock register updated with magic value
Violation: PWDATA matches magic value, address targets lock register, and lock holds same magic value
